supplement.text:
● **Multi-Shape Pole System:** One universal flagpole kit fits all flag shapes and styles, complete with a portable carry bag.

● **Universal Base Compatibility:** Our full range of ground bases and mounting accessories works seamlessly across all pole sizes and flag shapes.

● **Distinctive & Portable:** Eye-catching profile with quick, tool-free setup—ready to deploy anywhere in minutes.

● **Indoor & Outdoor Versatility:** Engineered to perform across a wide variety of indoor venues and outdoor environments.

● **Refined Craftsmanship:**  Finished with continuous, color-matched stitching along the seams for a clean, uninterrupted graphic display.
supplement.title: One Hardware System, Endless Display Possibilities

supplement.imageAlt: Wolflag feather and teardrop flag size comparison chart from 7ft to 13ft shown next to people for real-life height scale.
supplement.title: Find the Right Flag Height for Your Venue (7' to 13')
supplement.text: Compare our assembled flag heights against real-life human scale to choose the ideal size for your project. Compact 7'–9' flags offer safe ceiling clearance for indoor trade shows and lobbies, while towering 10'–13' flags deliver maximum roadside visibility for outdoor events and storefronts.

supplement.title: Quick, Tool-Free Assembly in 5 Easy Steps
supplement.text: Engineered for fast event deployment, our hybrid fiberglass and aluminum flagpole system sets up in under two minutes—no tools or extra hands required. Follow the sequence below to assemble your pole from top to bottom for a smooth, taut, and wrinkle-free display every time.
supplement.imageAlt: 5-step assembly instructions diagram showing how to connect the fiberglass and aluminum flagpole, slide on the Wolflag beach feather flag, and adjust tension.
